photos.title: Country land outside Loris, from above
photos.what: Straight down on the country northwest of the City of Loris on 2023 NAIP imagery: two country roads meet at a corner; along them, about thirty houses and manufactured homes sit on wide grassy lots with sheds, gardens and gravel drives; plowed farm fields across the road on the right and at the top; pine woods and a wet hollow at the lower left.
photos.caption: Country land outside Loris from above: wide lots along two country roads, plowed fields, pine woods and a wet hollow.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of country land outside Loris: houses and manufactured homes on wide grassy lots along two country roads, plowed farm fields, pine woods and a wet hollow

place.sublocation: Unincorporated Horry County, about 3 km northwest of the City of Loris (ZIP code area 29569)

photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-04, a 900 by 675 m window centred on 34.0748 N, 78.912 W; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /invest/where-to-buy/ in this batch: The National Map offers "free downloads of public domain, NAIP compressed orthoimagery"; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information "may be freely distributed or copied, but use of appropriate byline/photo/image credits is requested."
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (2000 x 1500) by the writer on 2026-11-04. Window centred on a point chosen from the county parcel points of the Loris area where most house lots are an acre or more (fix round 1, 2026-11-04: the owner's reviewer asked for a frame that shows the land, not downtown). No label is drawn; the caption names no business, street or subdivision. No person, plate or sign is readable at 60 cm. Reused for /buyers/land/ on 2026-11-13 from the same NAIP export (source_request re-run, 2000 x 1500), looked at full size again: the fields, the wide lots, the pine woods and the wet hollow are all in frame.
